item.title: Ep. 195 - Make Them Feel Good [Business 300]
item.description:
What if you ran an ad for your business that started with: “You’ll feel good after giving us your money."

That's catchy. You'd probably get people's attention. But could you say that to your customers with a straight face, and stand behind it?

Maybe you think it sounds presumptuous. Or haughty. Or too on-the-nose. Maybe you wouldn't run that sort of ad because it makes you look self-seeking or money-loving. Maybe you think it misses the point of what you're trying to do with your business.

item.title: Ep. 194 - The Job of Business Finance - Part 3 [Business 300]
item.description:
In the last episode, I mentioned the first 2: Data and Analysis.

This brings us to the 3rd value-add: Insight. With the data collected and turned into information through analysis, now the job of finance is to delivery insight.

item.title: Ep. 193 - The Job of Business Finance - Part 2 [Business 300]
item.description:
In all your undertakings, you want substance, not fluff. We're tempted towards fluff, but, as business owners, we really can't afford it. There's no place for it.

The temptation for fluff is especially true in Finance. Fancy charts and complicated spreadsheets masquerade as substance. Irrelevant ratios and misleading statistics might give a semblance of control. It's easy for fluff to arise from Finance.

So, what should your Finance department produce in order for it's output to be meaningful and valuable?

I have 4 things to work through.
item.author: Philip Kulishov
item.itunes:author: Philip Kulishov

item.title: Ep. 192 - The Job of Business Finance - Part 1 [Business 300]
item.description:
One of the areas where business people are tempted towards irrelevant fluff is in the area of Finance. There are so many metrics that could be tracked, so many numbers that could be calculated, so many ratios and statistics that could be presented. If it wanted to, the Finance Department could be the business BS department. 

The 4 things that the Finance Department should focus on in order to provide value to customers and owners are Data, Analysis, Insight, and Action.

item.title: Ep. 191 - When It's Time To Scale Back [Business 300]
item.description:
If you have to scale back and take on roles that you previously delegated while you rebuild, do it.

Yes it sucks. But sitting and moping, wishing it were not so as you wait for things to pan out on their own is not an option for you. All things considered, you have to know when it's time to scale back.
